Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Keep retrying the selected beast until capture is confirmed.
- Resume nearby capture attempts without returning to the spawn-circle center.
- Follow moving targets while waiting to apply Capture.
- Defend against incidental attackers, then resume capture travel or patrol.
- Recover stalled fights after 8 seconds without damage on the marked target.
- Try other points inside the spawn circle when the center has no mapped route.
- Patrol the circle after arrival; approach distant beasts before selecting them.

Full details on GitHub repo:
